license: fixture-only, not a real biological dataset
provenance_note: Synthetic, committed offline single-cell fixture for the WP-17 donor-level pseudobulk route and its adversarial tests. Cells carry explicit donor / cell_type / condition labels so donor-level aggregation is auditable. Honestly labelled synthetic data; never present as real. Cells within a donor are NOT independent replicates — the donor is the statistical unit.
known_limitations: Synthetic single-cell counts; results are for pipeline validation only, not biological discovery.
A single cell type; cells within a donor are not independent replicates.
